caption: The drawing depicts a decorative chair back and upper portions of its legs, rendered mainly in black and yellow tones. The top rail is curved and embellished with symmetrical motifs, including a central lyre flanked by leaves, round medallions, stylized floral elements, and scrolls. Below the rail is a rectangular panel with slanted sides, prominently featuring a fruit arrangement composed of a central pumpkin-like gourd, two round fruits, star-shaped flowers, and overlapping leaves in yellow, with fine shading to indicate depth. The vertical stiles on either side of the panel are decorated with floral and leaf designs, alongside three stacked ring-like accents at the base of each leg section. The entire composition rests on a plain, light background, and the artist's name, "Laurence Flynn," is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Hitchcock Chair Back
